prompt.image: split frame alternating a pale lilac paper field and a deep indigo field, thick black typographic weight on the light side, one cool blue progress rule on the dark side, thin outlined badges stacked in a column, flat graphic lighting, no text. Palette bg:#0b0e1a, bgLight:#eceef8, surface:#1a1f33, paper:#f7f8fc, accent:#4f7dff, warning:#ff5c8a, stamp:#c084fc. Type NotoSansSC 900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: two-tone fields, thick underline, outlined badge, progress rule, list card. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 清单逐行盖章: 起行 → 逐行确认 → 一枚否决章 → 全部落定 → 落版. Motion: light/dark hard cut, circle mask grow, badge pop-in, rule draw. Transition: 纯硬切. Captions: 左下入库标签. Sound: 机械音. Hook pattern: [时间]，找到 [目标]。. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 poster, upper half pale lilac field with a heavy black bar and an underline stroke, lower half deep indigo field with one blue rule and three outlined badges, hard horizontal split, no readable text. Hook: 倒计时. Hero motif: two-tone fields. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
prompt.negative: reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, light sweep, halftone wipe, flash white, center keyword sticker, metal title slam, riser/whoosh/shimmer, gibberish Chinese text, logos, watermarks
